eval.description: OpenAI agentic protein-design eval on a proprietary binding dataset. The model must pick the true binder among highly similar candidate sequences for the same target hotspot when structure-tool confidence scores alone are not enough. Scored as pass@k over attempts. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether AI agents can pick the true protein binder among very similar candidate sequences.

links.title: GPT-Rosalind-5.5 system card (Hard negative protein binding prediction)

versions.changes: Proprietary non-contaminated binder set (cards cite 43 targets and 492 hotspots); pass@4 is the usual reported metric.

scores.description: The model identified the true binder among the hard-negative candidates for that hotspot.

metrics.description: Pass@4 over attempts. Some cards also report pass@1.
